race_context: The district: the Community School Corporation of Eastern Hancock County serves the eastern third of Hancock County, including Wilkinson, Shirley, Charlottesville, Warrington, Willow Branch and parts of Greenfield {wiki_ehhs}. Dr. George Philhower is superintendent {doe_newsletter}{wiki_ehhs}. Eastern Hancock High School enrolled 378 students in 2023-24 {wiki_ehhs}; a current district-wide enrollment figure was not found in a source read for this profile.

The board has five members serving four-year terms: one from each of the district's three townships (Brown, Jackson and Blue River) and two at-large members {eh_board}. The district's posted schedule lists the Brown Township seat and one at-large seat for November 2026, and the Jackson Township, Blue River Township and other at-large seats for November 2028 {eh_board}. The district page lists members Jim Jackson (president), Tammy Stunda (first vice president), Steve Brock (second vice president), Ryan Nasby (assistant secretary) and Evan Roberts (secretary) {eh_board}. Meetings are normally held on the second Monday of the month at the corporation office in Charlottesville {eh_board}.

Seat names: the county ballot uses numbered districts rather than township names. In 2024 the ballot carried Eastern Hancock 'At-Large', 'DST 2' and 'DST 3' races, when the district schedule shows the Jackson and Blue River seats and one at-large seat were up {hc_2024}{eh_board}. The 2026 'District 1' race therefore appears to be the Brown Township seat; the county and district sources read for this profile do not state that directly {hc_list}{eh_board}.

Seats on the 2026 ballot: one District 1 seat and one at-large seat, each vote for 1, consistent with the district's schedule {eh_board}{hc_list}{in_list}. Board secretary Evan Roberts is the only candidate for District 1, and board first vice president Tammy Stunda faces Rosina T. (Rose) Metz for the at-large seat {eh_board}{hc_list}. The district page does not say which seat each member holds {eh_board}.
Party labels: all three candidates are listed as Republicans on the county and state lists {hc_list}{in_list}.

2024 results: Steve Brock was unopposed for the at-large seat, James R. Jackson Jr. was unopposed in District 3, and Johnna S. Bridges defeated Rosina T (Rose) Metz in District 2, 1,618 votes to 724 {hc_2024}. Bridges is not on the board list now posted by the district, which includes Ryan Nasby {eh_board}; how the District 2 seat changed hands was not found in a source read for this profile.

Microschool and career programs (2026): an April 17, 2026 Indiana Department of Education newsletter described a visit to Eastern Hancock High School, where about one-third of juniors and seniors take part in work-based learning, and to Nature's Gift Microschool at Nameless Creek, the district's first microschool, which the newsletter said was created in response to feedback from families who had been homeschooling {doe_newsletter}.

2027 budget: the board's 2026 calendar lists a regular meeting and budget hearing on Sept. 28, 2026, followed by a regular meeting on Oct. 21, 2026 {eh_board}. Budget figures, the effect of the 2025 property-tax law (SEA 1) and any referendum plans were not found in a source read for this profile.
Forums: no candidate forum or newspaper questionnaire for this race was found as of Oct. 10, 2026.
